bias.en: Neutral to bullish · pressing on the 100-day
bias.zh: 中性偏多 · 正挑战100日均线

read.en: Alphabet has spent three weeks in a tight $336–364 range. Price is above its 5, 10, 30 and 200-day averages and sits right at the 100-day ($353), which is still edging down. MACD crossed above its signal on Oct 5 and is building, RSI is 56, and Parabolic SAR turned bullish on Oct 8. Volatility is low for this group, at about 2.4% a day.
read.zh: Alphabet 三周来在 $336–364 窄幅区间内运行。股价位于 5 日、10 日、30 日和 200 日均线上方，正处于仍小幅下行的 100 日均线（$353）。MACD 于 10月5日上穿信号线并持续增强，RSI 为 56，抛物线 SAR 于 10月8日转多。日均波幅约 2.4%，在这组股票中偏低。

read.en: A close above $356 (the 100-day plus the Oct 8 high) would be the first step; $364 is the top of the range and $378 is a level that capped five rallies in July and August. Support starts at $343–345 (10 and 30-day averages), then $336–339, the bottom of the range and a level tested five times since April.
read.zh: 收盘站上 $356（100 日均线与 10月8日高点）是第一步；$364 为区间顶部，$378 为 7、8 月五次压制反弹的位置。支撑首先在 $343–345（10 日与 30 日均线），其次 $336–339，即区间底部，4月以来五次测试。
